article.title: Mexico detains ex-prosecutor on treason charges over CIA raid
article.author: Editor
article.content: A Mexican federal judge has ordered pretrial detention for former Chihuahua prosecutor César Jáuregui Moreno over a drug-lab operation involving CIA agents. The case has intensified tensions between state and federal authorities over national sovereignty and foreign involvement in security operations. The post Mexico detains ex-prosecutor on treason charges over CIA raid appeared first on MR Online .
